seo.title: Agent Finder — Seniors Property Advisors
seo.description: Compare trusted local real estate agents, understand what selling will cost, and choose with confidence — with independent Australian guidance at every step, and nothing to sell you.

data.heading: Find the right real estate agent,
data.lead: We help Australian homeowners compare trusted local agents, understand their options, and make confident selling decisions — guided by an independent property advisor, not a salesperson.

image.alt: A property advisor with a tablet talking with a senior couple in their living room

data.heading: Choosing an agent shouldn’t feel
data.lead: Picking the wrong agent can cost homeowners tens of thousands — in commission, marketing, and a price that falls short. Agent Finder gives you a calm, guided way to compare your options before you commit.

items.title: Compare trusted local agents
items.body: We shortlist agents who actually work — and recently sold — in your suburb, not just anyone willing to pay for leads.

items.title: Understand fees & marketing
items.body: See realistic commission and marketing costs side‑by‑side, with plain‑English notes on what’s reasonable for your area.

items.title: Get independent support
items.body: A real property advisor stays beside you — from the first conversation to signing the agreement. No agent pressure.

data.heading: Four conversations, and
data.headingEm: no obligation at any of them.
data.body: It starts with a phone call about your home and when you might want to move. We do the research, bring you a shortlist you can actually compare, and stay in the room while you decide. Most people speak to us months before they list — that is the useful time to ask, not the week before.

image.alt: An advisor showing a tablet to an older couple across a table

data.heading: Plain answers to the questions
data.lead: Short pieces on downsizing, agent fees and the practical side of selling later in life.

data.heading: Ready to find
data.body: Start with a free, no‑pressure conversation. We’ll help you understand your options — and only move forward when it feels right.
